meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描蛋白序列里的 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T,中间不接脯氨酸),按局部 S/T 密度预测 O-糖基化热点,并能把某个位点突变掉或新增一个糖基化位点。
howto.when: 当你提到抗体工程、疫苗抗原设计、生物类似药糖型对比等任务,或给出蛋白序列要求找糖基化位点时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段序列的 N-糖基化位点
say.note: 返回位点、motif 和前后文

say.text: 把 IgG1 Fc 第 297 位天冬酰胺改成谷氨酰胺
say.note: 去掉该糖基化位点,返回突变后序列

say.text: 预测这条序列的 O-糖基化热点

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T, X not proline), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots from local S/T density, and can mutate a site out or add a new one.
howto.when_en: Triggers on antibody engineering, vaccine antigen design, or biosimilar glycan comparison, and when you give a protein sequence and ask for glycosylation sites.

say_en.text: Scan this sequence for N-glycosylation sequons
Change Asn297 in IgG1 Fc to Gln
say_en.note: Removes that glycan site; returns mutated sequence

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence
